blocks.html:
The parameters accepted by `GET /store/products/search`.

The filters are narrower than `StoreProductListParams`: each one has to
exist as a filterable field on the product search index, and a search engine
rejects a filter on a field its index doesn't hold.

types.name: region_id
types.description: The ID of the customer's region. This parameter must be included if you want to apply taxes on the product variant's price.

types.name: country_code
types.description: The customer's country code. This parameter must be included if you want to apply taxes on the product variant's price.

types.name: province
types.description: The lower-case [ISO 3166-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO\_3166-2) province, which can be taken from a customer's address. This parameter helps further narrowing down the taxes applied on a the product variant's prices.

types.name: cart_id
types.description: The ID of the customer's cart, if available. If set, the cart's region and shipping address's country code and province are used instead of the `region_id`, `country_code`, and `province` parameters.

types.name: q
types.description: The free-text query matched against the index' searchable fields.

types.name: sales_channel_id
types.description:
Filter by the sales channel(s) the product is available in. Must be a
subset of the sales channels the publishable key is scoped to.

types.name: fields
types.description:
The dotted paths of the fields to return. Fields the index holds come back
from the search engine; anything else is fetched for the matching products
and merged in.

types.name: order
types.description:
The field to sort the results by, prefixed with `-` for descending order.
Left unset, results come back in relevance order.

types.name: limit
types.description: The maximum number of products to return.

types.name: offset
types.description: The number of products to skip before the returned ones.

types.name: locale
types.description: The locale code in BCP 47 format, used to localize the returned products.
